title: Identifying the Main Chain
text: In IUPAC naming, the longest carbon chain must contain the functional group (in this case, the double bond). Start counting from one end.

title: Carbon Prefixes
text: Remember the carbon prefixes: meth- (1), eth- (2), prop- (3), but- (4), pent- (5), hex- (6), hept- (7), oct- (8), non- (9), dec- (10).

title: Counting Carbons
